app.name: Stay in Kosovo
app.metaTitle: Stay in Kosovo - Places, plans and local favourites
app.metaDescription: Discover Kosovo through local favourites, mood-led recommendations, day plans and simple transport between the places worth your time.

offline.message: You're offline. Saved places and your draft plan are still available.

footer.description: A calm way to find places worth your time in Kosovo — and a simple plan for the day around them.
footer.creditsText: Place photography comes from Wikimedia Commons contributors and the businesses themselves, under CC BY-SA, CC0 or equivalent licences. Hero photograph of the Government of Kosovo building by Diego Delso, CC BY-SA 4.0.

hero.eyebrow: Kosovo · places, plans and local favourites
hero.title: Find your next place in Kosovo.
hero.description: From old-town coffee in Prizren to a quiet afternoon in Rugova. Browse by mood, save what you like, and let us shape the day around it.
hero.photoCredit: Photo: Diego Delso, CC BY-SA 4.0 — Wikimedia Commons

pulseHome.title: What's happening tonight?
pulseHome.description: A quick read on where people are heading, and where it's still quiet.
pulseHome.transitGood: Most buses and taxis are running normally.
pulseHome.transitOkay: Transport is running, with the odd delay.
pulseHome.transitSlow: Allow extra time — transport is slow right now.

vibesSection.title: What are you in the mood for?
vibesSection.description: Pick a feeling and we'll shape the places around it. You can always change your mind.

explore.title: Good places for a {{vibe}} day.
explore.description: A short list, chosen from what's nearby, what's open, and what people keep coming back to.
explore.emptyText: Try another mood, or open Discover to browse everything in Kosovo.
explore.errorTitle: We couldn't load places just now
explore.errorText: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.

flow.title: Three steps to a good day.
flow.description: No accounts needed to look around. Sign in when you want to save things.

mood.title: Pick a mood
mood.text: Slow and peaceful, something delicious, a night out, or an adventure — choose how you want the day to feel.

explore.title: See what fits
explore.text: We show places that match, with the honest details: how far, roughly what it costs, and whether it's open.

keep.title: Keep the good ones
keep.text: Save places as you go, then turn them into a simple plan you can follow on the day.

discover.title: Find the right place in Kosovo.
discover.description: Search and filter by mood, budget, rating, opening hours and how easy it is to reach.
discover.relaxedNotice: Nothing matched exactly, so here are the closest places instead.
discover.loadFallback: We couldn't reach live data, so you're seeing our saved Kosovo list.
discover.emptyText: Try widening the city, mood, type of place, or transport filters.

mapPanel.title: Map
mapPanel.subtitle: Every place on the map, with its real location.
mapPanel.demand: Based on saves, views, check-ins and events.

googleMap.label: Map of places across Kosovo
googleMap.emptyText: We only show places with a location we're confident about.
googleMap.staticFallbackText: The map uses OpenStreetMap tiles and our saved Kosovo places.

reviews.title: Tell people what it's actually like.
reviews.description: A few honest words help the next person far more than a star rating.
reviews.commentPlaceholder: Books, warm lights, easy conversation and a very local crowd...

itinerary.title: Let us build your day.
itinerary.description: Tell us where you are, how much time you have and what you're in the mood for. We'll put the day in a sensible order.
itinerary.emptyText: Try Nightlife for a Prishtina evening, Adventure for Rugova or Brezovica, or Local Food for a restaurant-led day.

mobility.title: How do you want to get there?
mobility.description: Walking, taxi, bus, bike or car — with a realistic time and cost for each.
mobility.routePending: Pick a starting point and a destination
mobility.noLocationsForCity: We don't have places listed for this city yet.
mobility.routeErrorDetail: Try a different starting point or destination.
mobility.routeRequestError: Something went wrong working out the route. Try again.
mobility.sameLocationError: Pick two different places to see a route.
mobility.routeVisualization: Where we can, we draw the real driving route. Otherwise you'll see a good estimate.
mobility.empty: Pick two places to compare travel options.

pulseConsole.title: Where people are heading tonight.
pulseConsole.mapText: Tap a place to see what's going on there.

business.dashboardText: See how people find you, what they save, and where they come from.
business.boostText: Paid visibility is always capped, so well-run places still win on their own merits.
business.photosText: Upload a few good photos. Natural daylight and real rooms work better than polished shots.
business.qrText: Let visitors check in with a QR code at the door — useful for regulars and repeat visits.
business.analyticsText: Based on views, saves, reviews, route requests and check-ins.
business.onboardingTitle: Put your place on the map.
business.onboardingText: Tell us about your place. We review every submission by hand before it goes live.

assistant.title: Ask about Kosovo
assistant.subtitle: A local hand when you're not sure what to do
assistant.initial: Ask for a good evening, a food tour, a quiet corner, or a plan that doesn't need a car.
assistant.error: We couldn't reach the assistant. Try again in a moment.

notFound.text: Let's get you back to something worth seeing.

vibeDescriptions.chill: Quiet cafes, green parks, easy walks and long views.
vibeDescriptions.nightlife: Bars, late kitchens, live sets and streets that stay busy.
vibeDescriptions.romantic: Sunset viewpoints, warm lighting, a slow dinner and a walk home.
vibeDescriptions.adventure: Mountains, canyons, ski slopes and days that use your legs.
vibeDescriptions.local-food: Traditional kitchens, modern bistros and markets worth the detour.
vibeDescriptions.hidden-gems: The places locals keep to themselves.
vibeDescriptions.family-friendly: Daytime, easy to reach, gentle pacing and room to run.
vibeDescriptions.culture: Museums, landmarks, architecture and the story of a place.
vibeDescriptions.sacred-spiritual: Monasteries, mosques, churches and quiet spaces for reflection.
vibeDescriptions.adventure-trails: Hikes, caves, waterfalls and routes for people who like to move.
vibeDescriptions.wildlife-nature: Protected landscapes, ethical wildlife encounters and slow days outdoors.
vibeDescriptions.living-history: Museums, memorials, bazaars and places where the past is still visible.
vibeDescriptions.ottoman-heritage: Old bazaars, hammams, stone bridges and narrow streets.
vibeDescriptions.city-life: Squares, boulevards, cafe terraces and where the city gathers.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Stay in Kosovo
onboarding.label: Welcome
onboarding.step1Text: Tell us how you want the day to feel — slow and peaceful, hungry, curious, or ready for a walk.
onboarding.step2Text: Every place comes with an honest location, an idea of cost, and how easy it is to reach.
onboarding.step3Text: Save the places you like and we'll put them in a sensible order for the day.
